en.title: Mobile phone explosion on e-Green Bus in Bahawalpur
en.dek: A student's phone exploded on an e-Green Bus, causing panic and damage.
facts: A mobile phone exploded on an e-Green Bus near Dring Stadium in Bahawalpur
The bus was travelling from Lodhran to Dera Bakha and was packed with male and female passengers
A student attempting to connect his phone to a charging port caused the explosion
The explosion filled the bus with smoke, prompting panic among passengers
Some passengers shattered windowpanes and door glass, while others jumped out of the moving vehicle
body: BAHAWALPUR: Passengers travelling in an e-Green Bus got panicked here on Friday, with some of them shattering its windowpanes and door glass, and some others jumping out of the moving vehicle, after a mobile phone exploded in the bus near Dring Stadium. According to witnesses, an e-Green Bus (BP-11) was going from Lodhran to Dera Bakha, packed with male and female passengers. As it reached near Dring Stadium, a student occupying a rear seat attempted to connect his mobile phone to a charging port in the bus.

As soon as he connected the charger’s wire to the port, the mobile phone exploded, filling the bus with smoke. This created panic among the passengers, with some of them shattering windowpanes and door glass and some others jumping out of the moving vehicle.
en.context: E-Green Buses are part of public transport initiatives in Pakistani cities. Incidents involving passenger electronics on board have previously raised safety concerns among commuters.

fr.title: Explosion de téléphone portable sur un bus e-Green à Bahawalpur
fr.dek: Le téléphone d'un étudiant explose sur un bus e-Green, provoquant la panique et des dégâts.
facts: Un téléphone portable a explosé sur un bus e-Green près du Dring Stadium à Bahawalpur
Le bus circulait de Lodhran à Dera Bakha et était rempli de passagers masculins et féminins
Un étudiant tentant de connecter son téléphone à un port de charge a provoqué l'explosion
L'explosion a rempli le bus de fumée, suscitant la panique parmi les passagers
Certains passagers ont brisé des vitres et des vitres de porte, tandis que d'autres sont sauts du véhicule en mouvement
body: BAHAWALPUR : Des passagers voyageant dans un bus e-Green ont paniqué vendredi à Bahawalpur, certains brisant les vitres et les portes du bus, d'autres sautant du véhicule en mouvement, après l'explosion d'un téléphone portable près du Dring Stadium. Selon des témoins, un bus e-Green (BP-11) circulait de Lodhran à Dera Bakha, rempli de passagers hommes et femmes. En approchant du Dring Stadium, un étudiant assis à l'arrière a tenté de connecter son téléphone portable à un port de charge du bus.

Dès qu'il a branché le câble du chargeur au port, le téléphone portable a explosé, remplissant le bus de fumée. Cela a provoqué la panique parmi les passagers, certains brisant les vitres et les portes et d'autres sautant du véhicule en mouvement.
fr.context: Les bus e-Green font partie des initiatives de transport public dans les villes pakistanaises. Des incidents impliquant des appareils électroniques de passagers à bord ont précédemment soulevé des préoccupations de sécurité chez les usagers.

pt.title: Explosão de telemóvel num autocarro e-Green em Bahawalpur
pt.dek: O telemóvel de um estudante explodiu num autocarro e-Green, causando pânico e danos.
facts: Um telemóvel explodiu num autocarro e-Green perto do Dring Stadium em Bahawalpur
O autocarro viajava de Lodhran para Dera Bakha e estava cheio de passageiros do sexo masculino e feminino
Um estudante que tentava ligar o telemóvel a uma porta de carregamento causou a explosão
A explosão encheu o autocarro de fumo, provocando pânico entre os passageiros
Alguns passageiros partiram vidros das janelas e das portas, enquanto outros saltaram do veículo em movimento
body: BAHAWALPUR: Passageiros que viajavam num autocarro e-Green ficaram em pânico na sexta-feira, com alguns a partir os vidros das janelas e das portas, e outros a saltar do veículo em movimento, após um telemóvel explodir no autocarro perto do Dring Stadium. Segundo testemunhas, um autocarro e-Green (BP-11) ia de Lodhran para Dera Bakha, repleto de passageiros do sexo masculino e feminino. Ao chegar perto do Dring Stadium, um estudante que ocupava um assento traseiro tentou ligar o seu telemóvel a uma porta de carregamento do autocarro.

Assim que ligou o fio do carregador à porta, o telemóvel explodiu, enchendo o autocarro de fumo. Isto causou pânico entre os passageiros, alguns dos quais partiram os vidros das janelas e das portas e outros saltaram do veículo em movimento.
pt.context: Os autocarros E-Green fazem parte de iniciativas de transporte público em cidades paquistanesas. Incidentes envolvendo eletrónica de passageiros a bordo levantaram anteriormente preocupações de segurança entre os utentes.

zh.title: 百色电动巴士爆炸事件引发恐慌
zh.dek: 学生手机在巴基斯坦巴瓦尔普尔一辆电动巴士上爆炸，造成损伤与恐慌
facts: 手机在巴瓦尔普尔靠近丁格体育场的电动巴士上爆炸
巴士正从洛德兰尔前往德拉巴卡，车上挤满男乘客和女乘客
学生试图将手机插入充电口时引发爆炸
爆炸充满了巴士内的烟雾，乘客惊恐四溢
部分乘客打破车窗和门玻璃，其他乘客从移动的车辆上跳下
body: 百色电动巴士爆炸事件引发恐慌 BAHAWALPUR：周五，乘客在一辆e-Green巴士上旅行时惊恐不已，有人打破了车窗和车门玻璃，还有人从移动的车辆上跳了下来，原因是一辆靠近Dring体育场的巴士上手机爆炸。据目击者称，一辆e-Green巴士（BP-11）从洛德兰前往德拉巴卡，车上挤满了男乘客和女乘客。当车辆靠近Dring体育场时，一名坐在后排的学生试图将手机插车上的充电口。
随着他将充电线插入车载充电口，手机爆炸了，巴士内充满了烟雾。这引发了乘客的恐慌，有人打破了车窗和车门玻璃，还有人从移动的车辆上跳了出去。
zh.context: 电动巴士是巴基斯坦城市公共交通倡议的一部分。此类涉及乘客电子产品的事件此前曾引发乘客安全担忧。

ja.title: 電話が爆発し、バーワルプルのe-グリーンバスでパニックと損傷
ja.dek: 学生の携帯電話が爆発し、損傷。パニックを引き起こす。
facts: 電話がドリンスタジアム近くでe-グリーンバスで爆発
バスはロドランからデラ・バッカへ向かっており、男女の乗客で混雑していた
充電ポートに接続しようとした学生が爆発の原因に
爆発によりバスが煙で満たされ、乗客の間でパニック
一部の乗客が窓ガラスとドアのガラスを割り、他の乗客が移動中の車両から飛び降りた
body: BAHAWALPUR：金曜日に、ドライングスタジアム近くで、ロドランからデラ・バッカへ向かっていたe-グリーンバス（BP-11）に乗車していた乗客がパニックに陥った。目撃者によると、バスは男女の乗客で満員だった。バスがドライングスタジアム付近に差し掛かったとき、後部座席にいた学生がバスの充電ポートに携帯電話を接続しようとした。
充電器のコードをポートに接続した直後に、携帯電話が爆発し、バス内に煙が充満した。これを受け、乗客の間でパニックが広がり、一部の乗客が窓ガラスやドアガラスを破壊し、他の乗客が移動中の車両から飛び降りた。
ja.context: e-グリーンバスはパキスタンの都市で公共交通機関の取り組みの一部。乗客の電子機器に関する以前の事例が通勤者の間で安全性への懸念を高めている。

problemsFixed: Headline uses 'flee' which is not in the source; source says some passengers jumped out of a moving vehicle, not that all fled.
Body paragraph 1 repeats the opening clause 'A mobile phone exploded...' from the previous paragraph (violates rule 13).
'According to witnesses' is present but the specific detail about the student connecting the charger is buried and not clearly attributed as the cause in the first sentence.
'Friday' is used but the source timestamp is 2026-11-21T04:05:11.000Z; the text says 'on Friday' which is acceptable but must be consistent.
Context section contains vague phrasing ('vehicle equipment') not supported by sources; sources describe a specific phone explosion, not general vehicle equipment issues.
Category 'health' is incorrect for a transport incident; should be 'world' or 'tech'.
Importance 3 is a placeholder; must be revised to match neutral assessment.
The dek ('Passengers fled...') is not a factual summary of the event per the sources.
